headline: Nepal receives approval to import up to 350 MW of electricity from India
summary: Nepal obtained authorization to import up to 350 megawatts of power from India through July 31, 2027, to mitigate domestic supply shortfalls caused by flood damage to hydropower plants.
why: Cross-border electricity trade in South Asia is critical for balancing seasonal hydroelectric fluctuations and preventing industrial blackout disruptions.

impacts.name: Nepal
impacts.why: Authorization to procure 350 MW of Indian electricity averts peak winter energy shortages.
